feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Water chiefs lash out at Ofwat governance reforms
articles.summary: Water industry bosses have hit out at reforms proposed by Ofwat, the industry regulator, which they claim would force them to recruit dozens of additional directors with the cost being borne by billpayers.

articles.title: Barclays to begin car finance payouts months before outcome of legal challenge
articles.summary: Barclays will this week become the first major UK lender to begin offering compensation payments to former motor finance customers, even as the industry's big financiers face waiting months for the outcome of challenges to a £9bn redress scheme.

articles.title: Ministers to hold urgent talks with Poundland chiefs
articles.summary: The government is to hold an urgent meeting with Poundland bosses amid growing recriminations over the discount retailer's ownership.

articles.title: National Grid sparks deal to pave way for giant UK data centre
articles.summary: National Grid has struck a deal paving the way for Britain’s biggest electricity substation to be built on Teesside as the government races to avoid missing out on global demand for AI infrastructure development.

articles.title: Majority of funds stolen in cryptocurrency hack replenished, Binance says
articles.summary: Around 90% of stolen cryptocurrency assets following a hack on a major exchange has been replenished, according to Binance.

articles.title: Buyout firm TDR Capital strikes €400m deal to buy Lovehoney
articles.summary: The private equity firm which owns Asda and Britain's biggest pubs operator has agreed a roughly €400m (£334m) takeover of Lovehoney Group, a big player in the fast-growing "intimate wellness" industry.

articles.title: Virgin Media O2 to axe thousands of jobs in sweeping shake-up
articles.summary: The telecoms giant Virgin Media O2 (VMO2) is to axe thousands of jobs as it slashes its cost base amid investor concerns about its ability to service its £22bn debt mountain.

articles.title: Poundland bidder tells administrator it remains keen on rescue deal
articles.summary: The Northern Irish company attempting to stage a solvent rescue of Poundland has told the discount retailer's administrator-in-waiting that it remains keen on a deal which could save more than 10,000 jobs.

articles.title: BP profits hit 18-year high as another bank makes billions
articles.summary: Profits at the UK-based oil and gas giant BP have hit an 18-year high, surpassing the level seen during the 2022 energy crisis.

articles.title: Crypto industry suffers 'largest bank heist in human history'
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency worth more than $6.3bn (£4.7bn) has been stolen from a major exchange - with one industry insider telling Sky News it is "the largest bank heist in human history".
